title: 第19章 是文物啊第20章 实践派
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
经过杨守小组一段时间的辛苦排查，几乎将三个省的灵气浓度探测完毕。
“李局、老师，经过我组将近一个月的探测，已大致将云省、春省、青省三省灵气浓度探测完毕。”
“其中云省灵气浓度1-5级，这里的灵气分布很广，整个省除了人员格外集中的城市内部，其余区域均含有灵气，越是人迹罕至的地方，其灵气浓度最高。”
“春省和青省的平均灵气浓度1-3级，这两个省市的灵气分布同样广，也是越少有人类开发的地方含量越高。”
“所以我做了以下猜想，人类活动的活跃度和灵气含量浓度呈现负相关。”
李局和常老露出思考的神色，很快常老道，“我认为你的猜想有一定合理性，但非事情全貌，你一直在外检测，还不知道基地的最新消息。”
“近一个月来，东国全国34个省市中，检测出灵气的省份共8个，根据各个探测小组传回的消息，这些省份的灵气浓度高的地方普遍在人类活动少的区域，这看起来佐证了你的猜想，但其实不然。”
“我们把视角拉高一些，从宏观的角度来看，国内的灵气分布几乎全在南方，越往北，灵气浓度约低，过了源江后，整个北方地区的灵气含量几乎为0。”
“这样的分布规律，其中肯定蕴含着某些我们还不知道的原因。”
三人的会议室一时沉默下来。
是啊，东国接触到修真文明也才短短两个月，想要在这么短的时间内摸清其中规律，实在有些强人所难了。
雪白的桌面上，李局的手机突然发出震动，嗡嗡的声音在会议室中显得格外明显。
三人的目光都投向那部手机，看清打电话的人后，李局不顾还在开会，接通电话。
“李局，我有紧急的情况需要向你汇报。就在刚才，我们的工作人员在进行南口博物馆灵气浓度测试时，灵气浓度检测仪数值爆表了。”
李局刷的一下站起，“哪件文物导致灵气浓度检测仪数值爆表了？”
“是一件来自旧石器时代的骨锥，我猜测这件骨锥的灵气含量应该比能探测到的10级还要高。”
“我们这就让人带着检测量更大的灵气浓度检测仪过来！”
李局亲自带着常老和杨守去南口博物馆进行二次检测。
超高精度灵气分析仪能检测的灵气含量已经到达了50级，这是研发人员开发时都难以想象的高度，当初他们设计这个机器，只是为了以防万一，没想真的能排上用场。
更没想到的是，用这台机器去测骨锥时，竟然也数值爆表了！

“关于骨锥的历史来源找拿到么？”
“拿到了，根据相关史料，这跟骨锥出土自南口的马窑遗址，距今约有一万年。
没有关于这根骨锥的特殊记载，但是在同期挖掘出的文物中，有一个陶盆上的纹饰图案引起了功法组的注意。”
平板上，陶盆上的纹饰图案清晰的被展现在李局眼前。
粗糙、简略的线条，组成了三副有关联性的图案。
第一副，圆形的线条代表太阳，太阳旁边有一个遮天蔽日的大鸟，大鸟和太阳之下，线条小人在跪拜。
content_en:
After a period of hard work by Yang Shou's team, the concentration of spiritual energy in the three provinces has almost been detected.
"Bureau Li, teacher, after nearly a month of detection by our team, we have roughly completed detecting the concentration of spiritual energy in Yun Province, Chun Province, and Qing Province."
"Among them, the spiritual energy concentration in Yun Province is level 1-5. The spiritual energy here is widely distributed. Except for the inner cities where people are particularly concentrated, the rest of the province contains spiritual energy. The more inaccessible places have the highest concentration of spiritual energy."
"The average spiritual energy concentration in Chun Province and Qinghai Province is 1-3. The spiritual energy in these two provinces and cities is equally widely distributed. The fewer places developed by humans, the higher the concentration."
"So I made the following conjecture. There is a negative correlation between the activity of human activities and the concentration of spiritual energy."
Director Li and Chang Lao looked thoughtful, and Chang Lao soon said, "I think your guess is reasonable, but it doesn't tell the whole story. You have been out testing and you don't know the latest news about the base."
"In the past month, out of the 34 provinces and cities in Dongguo, a total of 8 provinces have detected spiritual energy. According to the information returned by various detection teams, the places with high concentrations of spiritual energy in these provinces are generally in areas with little human activity. This seems to support your conjecture, but it is not."
"Let's raise the perspective a little higher. From a macro perspective, almost all the spiritual energy in the country is distributed in the south. The farther north you go, the less spiritual energy concentration. After crossing the Yuanjiang River, the spiritual energy content in the entire northern region is almost 0."
"Such a distribution pattern must contain some reasons that we don't know yet."
The conference room of three people fell silent for a moment.
Yes, Dongguo has only been exposed to cultivation civilization for just two months. It is really difficult to figure out the rules in such a short period of time.
On the snow-white desktop, Director Li's cell phone suddenly vibrated, and the buzzing sound was particularly obvious in the conference room.
The three of them all turned their attention to the mobile phone. After seeing the caller clearly, Director Li answered the call regardless of the fact that he was still in a meeting.
"Director Li, I have an urgent situation that I need to report to you. Just now, when our staff was conducting a spiritual energy concentration test at the Nankou Museum, the value of the spiritual energy concentration detector exceeded the limit."
Director Li quickly stood up, "Which cultural relic caused the value of the spiritual energy concentration detector to explode?"
"It's an bone awl from the Paleolithic Age. I guess the aura content of this bone awl should be higher than the detectable level 10."
"We'll have someone come over with a spiritual energy concentration detector with a larger detection capacity!"
Director Li personally took Chang Lao and Yang Shou to the Nankou Museum for a secondary test.
The aura content that the ultra-high-precision aura analyzer can detect has reached level 50, which is a level that was unimaginable by the developers when it was developed. They originally designed this machine just in case, and did not expect it to be really useful.
What was even more unexpected was that when I used this machine to measure the bone awl, the results actually exceeded the charts!
"Can you find the historical origin of the ossuary awl?"
"I got it. According to relevant historical data, this bone awl was unearthed from the Mayao site in Nankou, about 10,000 years ago.
There is no special record about this bone awl, but among the cultural relics excavated during the same period, the pattern on a pottery basin attracted the attention of the Gongfa team. "
On the tablet, the decorative patterns on the pottery basin were clearly displayed in front of Director Li's eyes.
Rough and simple lines form three related patterns.
In the first pair, the circular lines represent the sun. Next to the sun is a big bird that blocks out the sky. Under the big bird and the sun, a small figure with lines is kneeling in worship.
